verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἐγγίζουσιν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα εἰς Βηθφαγὴ καὶ Βηθανίαν πρὸς τὸ ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν ἀποστέλλει δύο τῶν αὐτοῦ μαθητῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai hote engizousin eis Hierosolyma eis Bēthphagē kai Bēthanian pros to oros tōn Elaiōn apostellei dyo tōn autou mathētōn
verses.literal: - As they approached . . . Jerusalem [and came] to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount - of Olives [Jesus] sent out two of His disciples

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ὑπάγετε εἰς τὴν κώμην τὴν κατέναντι ὑμῶν καὶ εὐθὺς εἰσπορευόμενοι εἰς αὐτὴν εὑρήσετε πῶλον δεδεμένον ἐφ’ ὃν οὐδεὶς ἀνθρώπων οὔπω ἐκάθισεν λύσατε αὐτὸν καὶ φέρετε
verses.transliteration: kai legei autois Hypagete eis tēn kōmēn tēn katenanti hymōn kai euthys eisporeuomenoi eis autēn heurēsete pōlon dedemenon eph’ hon oudeis anthrōpōn oupō ekathisen lysate auton kai pherete
verses.literal: and said to them Go into the village - ahead of you and as soon as you enter . . . it you will find a colt tied [there] on which no one . . . vvv has ever sat Untie it and bring [it here]

verses.original: καὶ ἐάν τις εἴπῃ ὑμῖν Τί ποιεῖτε τοῦτο εἴπατε Ὅτι Ὁ Κύριος ἔχει χρείαν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀποστέλλει πάλιν ὧδε αὐτὸν εὐθὺς
verses.transliteration: kai ean tis eipē hymin Ti poieite touto eipate Hoti HO Kyrios echei chreian autou kai apostellei palin hōde auton euthys
verses.literal: - If anyone asks - Why are you doing this tell [him] - The Lord vvv needs it and will return . . . . . . it shortly

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπῆλθον καὶ εὗρον πῶλον ἔξω ἐπὶ τοῦ ἀμφόδου δεδεμένον πρὸς θύραν καὶ λύουσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai apēlthon kai heuron pōlon exō epi tou amphodou dedemenon pros thyran kai lyousin auton
verses.literal: So they went and found [the] colt outside in the street tied at a doorway - They untied it

verses.original: καί τινες τῶν ἑστηκότων ἐκεῖ ἔλεγον αὐτοῖς Τί ποιεῖτε λύοντες τὸν πῶλον
verses.transliteration: kai tines tōn hestēkotōn ekei elegon autois Ti poieite lyontes ton pōlon
verses.literal: and some who were standing there asked . . . Why are you untying the colt

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ εἶπαν αὐτοῖς καθὼς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν καὶ ἀφῆκαν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: de Hoi eipan autois kathōs ho Iēsous eipen kai aphēkan autous
verses.literal: - - [The disciples] answered . . . as - Jesus had instructed [them] and [the people] gave them permission . . .

verses.original: καὶ φέρουσιν τὸν πῶλον πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἐπιβάλλουσιν αὐτῶν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῷ καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐπ’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai pherousin ton pōlon pros ton Iēsoun kai epiballousin autōn ta himatia autō kai ekathisen ep’ auton
verses.literal: Then they led the colt to - Jesus and threw their - cloaks over it and He sat on it

verses.original: Καὶ πολλοὶ ἔστρωσαν αὐτῶν τὰ ἱμάτια εἰς τὴν ὁδόν δὲ ἄλλοι στιβάδας κόψαντες ἐκ τῶν ἀγρῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai polloi estrōsan autōn ta himatia eis tēn hodon de alloi stibadas kopsantes ek tōn agrōn
verses.literal: - Many [ in the crowd ] spread their - cloaks on the road while others [spread] branches they had cut from the fields

verses.original: καὶ οἱ προάγοντες καὶ οἱ ἀκολουθοῦντες ἔκραζον Ὡσαννά Εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: kai hoi proagontes kai hoi akolouthountes ekrazon Hōsanna Eulogēmenos ho erchomenos en onomati Kyriou
verses.literal: - The [ones who] went ahead and those who followed were shouting Hosanna Blessed is He [who] comes in [the] name of [the] Lord

verses.original: Εὐλογημένη ἡ ἐρχομένη βασιλεία ἡμῶν τοῦ πατρὸς Δαυίδ Ὡσαννὰ ἐν τοῖς ὑψίστοις
verses.transliteration: Eulogēmenē hē erchomenē basileia hēmōn tou patros Dauid Hōsanna en tois hypsistois
verses.literal: Blessed [is] the coming kingdom of our - father David Hosanna in the highest

verses.original: Καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα εἰς τὸ ἱερόν καὶ περιβλεψάμενος πάντα τῆς ὥρας οὔσης ἤδη ὀψὲ ἐξῆλθεν εἰς Βηθανίαν μετὰ τῶν δώδεκα
verses.transliteration: Kai eisēlthen eis Hierosolyma eis to hieron kai periblepsamenos panta tēs hōras ousēs ēdē opse exēlthen eis Bēthanian meta tōn dōdeka
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] entered . . . Jerusalem [and went] into the temple [courts] - He looked around at everything [but since] [it] was already late He went out to Bethany with the Twelve

verses.original: Καὶ τῇ ἐπαύριον αὐτῶν ἐξελθόντων ἀπὸ Βηθανίας ἐπείνασεν
verses.transliteration: Kai tē epaurion autōn exelthontōn apo Bēthanias epeinasen
verses.literal: - The next day [when] they had left . . . Bethany [Jesus] was hungry

verses.original: καὶ ἰδὼν ἀπὸ μακρόθεν συκῆν ἔχουσαν φύλλα ἦλθεν εὑρήσει εἰ ἄρα τι ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ ἐλθὼν ἐπ’ αὐτὴν εὗρεν οὐδὲν εἰ μὴ φύλλα γὰρ ἦν οὐκ ὁ καιρὸς σύκων
verses.transliteration: kai idōn apo makrothen sykēn echousan phylla ēlthen heurēsei ei ara ti en autē kai elthōn ep’ autēn heuren ouden ei mē phylla gar ēn ouk ho kairos sykōn
verses.literal: - Seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf He went to see if there was any [fruit] on it But when He reached . . . it He found nothing [on it] except . . . leaves since it was not the season for figs

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτῇ μηδεὶς Μηκέτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα φάγοι ἐκ σοῦ καρπὸν καὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἤκουον
verses.transliteration: kai apokritheis eipen autē mēdeis Mēketi eis ton aiōna phagoi ek sou karpon kai autou hoi mathētai ēkouon
verses.literal: Then vvv He said to [the tree] {May} no one ever . . . . . . . . . eat of your fruit {again} And His - disciples heard [this statement]

verses.original: Καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα Καὶ εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν ἤρξατο ἐκβάλλειν τοὺς ἀγοράζοντας καὶ τοὺς πωλοῦντας ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ κατέστρεψεν τὰς τραπέζας τῶν κολλυβιστῶν καὶ τὰς καθέδρας τῶν πωλούντων τὰς περιστερὰς
verses.transliteration: Kai erchontai eis Hierosolyma Kai eiselthōn eis to hieron ērxato ekballein tous agorazontas kai tous pōlountas en tō hierō kai katestrepsen tas trapezas tōn kollybistōn kai tas kathedras tōn pōlountōn tas peristeras
verses.literal: When they arrived in Jerusalem - [Jesus] entered . . . the temple [courts] [and] began to drive out those who were buying and - selling vvv vvv [there] - He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling - doves

verses.original: καὶ οὐκ ἤφιεν ἵνα τις διενέγκῃ σκεῦος διὰ τοῦ ἱεροῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ouk ēphien hina tis dienenkē skeuos dia tou hierou
verses.literal: And vvv He would not allow - anyone to carry merchandise through the temple [courts]

verses.original: καὶ ἐδίδασκεν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἔλεγεν Οὐ γέγραπται ὅτι μου Ὁ οἶκός κληθήσεται οἶκος προσευχῆς πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν δὲ ὑμεῖς πεποιήκατε αὐτὸν Σπήλαιον λῃστῶν
verses.transliteration: kai edidasken autois kai elegen Ou gegraptai hoti mou Ho oikos klēthēsetai oikos proseuchēs pasin tois ethnesin de hymeis pepoiēkate auton Spēlaion lēstōn
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] began to teach them and He declared vvv Is it not written - My - house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations But you have made it a den of robbers

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς ἤκουσαν καὶ ἐζήτουν πῶς ἀπολέσωσιν αὐτὸν γὰρ ἐφοβοῦντο αὐτόν γὰρ ὁ πᾶς ὄχλος ἐξεπλήσσετο ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ τῇ διδαχῇ
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi archiereis kai hoi grammateis ēkousan kai ezētoun pōs apolesōsin auton gar ephobounto auton gar ho pas ochlos exeplēsseto epi autou tē didachē
verses.literal: When the chief priests and - scribes heard [this] - they looked for a way to kill Him For they were afraid of Him because the whole crowd was astonished at His - teaching

verses.original: Καὶ ὅταν ὀψὲ ἐγένετο ἐξεπορεύοντο ἔξω τῆς πόλεως
verses.transliteration: Kai hotan opse egeneto exeporeuonto exō tēs poleōs
verses.literal: And when evening came [Jesus and His disciples] went out of the city

verses.original: Καὶ παραπορευόμενοι πρωῒ εἶδον τὴν συκῆν ἐξηραμμένην ἐκ ῥιζῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai paraporeuomenoi prōi eidon tēn sykēn exērammenēn ek rhizōn
verses.literal: [As] they were walking back in the morning they saw the fig tree withered from [its] roots

verses.original: καὶ ὁ Πέτρος ἀναμνησθεὶς λέγει αὐτῷ ἴδε Ῥαββί ἡ συκῆ ἣν κατηράσω ἐξήρανται
verses.transliteration: kai ho Petros anamnēstheis legei autō ide Rhabbi hē sykē hēn katērasō exērantai
verses.literal: - - Peter remembered [it] [and] said - Look Rabbi The fig tree - You cursed has withered

verses.original: Ἔχετε πίστιν θεοῦ Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀποκριθεὶς λέγει αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Echete pistin theou Kai ho Iēsous apokritheis legei autois
verses.literal: Have faith in God - - Jesus vvv said to them

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὃς ἂν εἴπῃ τούτῳ τῷ ὄρει Ἄρθητι καὶ βλήθητι εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ μὴ διακριθῇ ἐν αὐτοῦ τῇ καρδίᾳ ἀλλὰ πιστεύῃ ὅτι ὃ λαλεῖ γίνεται ἔσται αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: amēn legō hymin hoti hos an eipē toutō tō orei Arthēti kai blēthēti eis tēn thalassan kai mē diakrithē en autou tē kardia alla pisteuē hoti ho lalei ginetai estai autō
verses.literal: Truly I tell you that if anyone . . . says to this - mountain Be lifted up and thrown into the sea and vvv has no doubt in his - heart but believes that vvv [it] will happen it will be done for him

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο λέγω ὑμῖν πάντα ὅσα καὶ αἰτεῖσθε προσεύχεσθε πιστεύετε ὅτι ἐλάβετε καὶ ἔσται ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: dia touto legō hymin panta hosa kai aiteisthe proseuchesthe pisteuete hoti elabete kai estai hymin
verses.literal: Therefore . . . I tell you vvv whatever - you ask for in prayer believe that you have received [it] and [it] will be yours

verses.original: Καὶ ὅταν στήκετε προσευχόμενοι εἴ ἔχετε τι κατά τινος ἀφίετε ἵνα ὑμῶν ὁ Πατὴρ ὁ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς ἀφῇ ὑμῖν ὑμῶν τὰ παραπτώματα καὶ
verses.transliteration: Kai hotan stēkete proseuchomenoi ei echete ti kata tinos aphiete hina hymōn ho Patēr ho en tois ouranois aphē hymin hymōn ta paraptōmata kai
verses.literal: And when you stand to pray if you hold anything against [another] forgive [it] so that your - Father - in - heaven will forgive vvv your - trespasses as well

verses.original: Καὶ ἔρχονται πάλιν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ αὐτοῦ περιπατοῦντος ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ἔρχονται πρὸς αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: Kai erchontai palin eis Hierosolyma kai autou peripatountos en tō hierō hoi archiereis kai hoi grammateis kai hoi presbyteroi erchontai pros auton
verses.literal: - After their return . . . to Jerusalem . . . [Jesus] was walking in the temple [courts] [and] the chief priests - - scribes and - elders came up to Him

verses.original: Ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ποιεῖς ταῦτα καὶ ἔλεγον αὐτῷ ἢ τίς ἔδωκεν σοι ταύτην τὴν ἐξουσίαν ἵνα ποιῇς ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: En poia exousia poieis tauta kai elegon autō ē tis edōken soi tautēn tēn exousian hina poiēs tauta
verses.literal: By what authority are You doing these things - they asked - [And] who gave You - the authority to do [them]

verses.original: Ἐπερωτήσω ὑμᾶς ἕνα λόγον δὲ Ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἀποκρίθητέ μοι καὶ ἐρῶ ὑμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ποιῶ ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: Eperōtēsō hymas hena logon de Ho Iēsous eipen autois kai apokrithēte moi kai erō hymin en poia exousia poiō tauta
verses.literal: I will ask you one question - - Jesus replied . . . and [if] you answer Me - I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things

verses.original: Ἰωάννου τὸ βάπτισμα τὸ ἦν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἢ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων ἀποκρίθητέ μοι
verses.transliteration: Iōannou to baptisma to ēn ex ouranou ē ex anthrōpōn apokrithēte moi
verses.literal: John’s - baptism - was it from heaven or from men Answer Me

verses.original: Καὶ διελογίζοντο πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς Τί εἴπωμεν λέγοντες Ἐὰν εἴπωμεν Ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἐρεῖ Διὰ τί οὖν οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai dielogizonto pros heautous Ti eipōmen legontes Ean eipōmen Ex ouranou erei Dia ti oun ouk episteusate autō
verses.literal: - They deliberated among themselves what they should answer - If we say From heaven He will ask Why . . . then vvv did you not believe him

verses.original: ἀλλὰ εἴπωμεν Ἐξ ἀνθρώπων ἐφοβοῦντο τὸν ὄχλον γὰρ ἅπαντες εἶχον τὸν Ἰωάννην ὄντως ὅτι ἦν προφήτης
verses.transliteration: alla eipōmen Ex anthrōpōn ephobounto ton ochlon gar hapantes eichon ton Iōannēn ontōs hoti ēn prophētēs
verses.literal: But if we say From men they were afraid of the people for they all held that John truly - was a prophet

verses.original: καὶ ἀποκριθέντες τῷ Ἰησοῦ λέγουσιν Οὐκ οἴδαμεν Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτοῖς Οὐδὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ποιῶ ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: kai apokrithentes tō Iēsou legousin Ouk oidamen Kai ho Iēsous legei autois Oude egō legō hymin en poia exousia poiō tauta
verses.literal: So they answered - - - vvv We do not know And - Jesus replied . . . Neither {will} I tell you by what authority I am doing these things
